summary: Re-verified MediConnect frontend workflows against the public preview: all 10 supplied hospitals and doctor records render, expansion/capacity safety messaging and Maps links work, search and unavailable defaults work, console controls work, status-pill test IDs are unique, and desktop/mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing local/demo directory data only; no live medical availability was represented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend re-verification passed at desktop 1920px and mobile 390px. Firebase staff authentication, local staff session/ward state, directory data, and Google Maps links remain intentionally MOCKED because credentials are not configured.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1's duplicate generic status-pill IDs were resolved by adding a React useId-derived suffix in StatusPill. Browser verification found every rendered status-pill data-testid unique across the lookup page and console states; no remaining functional or layout issue was observed.
